text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oof, that's scabbed up real bad… It's so thick, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I think I was supposed to visit Grandmother next week… Or was it this week?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What if it isn't healed up by then?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I guess I should wear gloves when I go. Here's to hoping she won't find out…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer seems very concerned about her skin.
